name: hobbes_v1_create_custom_links
desc: Validate and accept 1-500 Custom Links as one asynchronous job. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. Automatic logo resolution runs independently of preview rendering when enabled. `generateThumbnails` defaults to true; false disables only preview rendering.

name: hobbes_v1_list_custom_links
desc: Return a paginated, filterable list of Custom Links in the key's organization.

params.name: email
params.desc: Exact prospect email address. URL-encode reserved characters.

params.name: engagement_stage
params.desc: Filter Custom Links by their monotonic not_opened, opened, started, or engaged stage.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_apply_custom_link_action
desc: Activate, deactivate, or move up to 500 Custom Links.

name: hobbes_v1_get_custom_link
desc: Return one Custom Link with its thumbnail state and Opened → Started → Engaged rollup.

name: hobbes_v1_update_custom_link
desc: Update personalization, sharing metadata, campaign membership, or active state. Thumbnail work is queued only when required; thumbnail-affecting updates require an `Idempotency-Key` header.

name: hobbes_v1_list_custom_link_sessions
desc: Return paginated session references and observed lifecycle timestamps for one Custom Link. Transcript content and visitor identifiers are not included.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_regenerate_custom_link_thumbnail
desc: Create an asynchronous job that regenerates this Custom Link's thumbnail. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

name: hobbes_v1_list_custom_link_jobs
desc: Return durable Custom Link job history, newest first.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_get_custom_link_job
desc: Return lightweight status and counters. Send `If-None-Match` with the previous ETag to receive `304 Not Modified` when unchanged.

name: hobbes_v1_list_custom_link_job_items
desc: Return paginated per-link creation, logo and thumbnail outcomes in deterministic input order, including `logoStatus`, `prospectLogoUrl`, and `shareThumbnailUrl` from the current persisted link. Wait for the job to finish and inspect warnings before using the p

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_cancel_custom_link_job
desc: Request cancellation of unfinished items. Completed work and consumed quota are retained.

name: hobbes_v1_retry_custom_link_job
desc: Create a child job for failed or selected items. Explicit thumbnail retries consume new render units and require an `Idempotency-Key` header.

name: hobbes_v1_list_custom_link_campaigns
desc: Return campaigns available to the key's organization.

name: hobbes_v1_create_custom_link_campaign
desc: Create a campaign backed by a context-pack folder.

name: hobbes_v1_get_custom_link_campaign
desc: Return one campaign and its Custom Link count.

name: hobbes_v1_update_custom_link_campaign
desc: Rename a campaign.

name: hobbes_v1_delete_custom_link_campaign
desc: Delete a campaign and unfile its Custom Links without deleting them.

name: hobbes_v1_get_custom_link_campaign_engagement
desc: Return raw generated-link, Opened, Started, Engaged, lead, meeting, visitor, page-view, session, and bot-only counts. Generated links are not a delivered-send denominator.

name: hobbes_v1_get_playbook
desc: Return structured staging and production Playbooks, section metadata, exact staging ETag and versions, and canonical agent links. Every Playbook response names the Role it acted on: the public API acts on the organization's default Role. Legacy Playbooks remai

name: hobbes_v1_preview_playbook_update
desc: Validate restricted JSON Patch operations against a clone of staging and return a deterministic before/after summary. This endpoint never changes staging. Previews expire after 24 hours.

name: hobbes_v1_apply_playbook_update
desc: Apply an unexpired preview created by the same API key to staging. Staging drift fails without creating a version; repeated applies return the original result.

name: hobbes_v1_list_playbook_suggestions
desc: Return ready Hobbes-generated groups whose changes all target Playbook sections, including evidence and exact proposed payloads.

name: hobbes_v1_apply_playbook_suggestions
desc: Apply selected stored suggestion payloads exactly as generated, with generation-revision and ETag concurrency checks.

name: hobbes_v1_create_agent_publish_job
desc: Queue the exact current staging version for production publishing. Set confirmation to `publish_to_production`; Hobbes runs the existing conversation-test gate before changing production.

name: hobbes_v1_get_agent_publish_job
desc: Return queued, running, succeeded, or failed status, a safe failure reason, and the canonical production link after success.

name: hobbes_v1_list_sessions
desc: Return analyzed production sessions, newest first. Combine filters to find qualified, high-intent, or booked sessions.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_get_session
desc: Return one analyzed session with qualification, conversation milestones, Custom Link lifecycle, topics, objections, tracking, and next steps.

name: hobbes_v1_get_session_transcript
desc: Return the ordered conversation transcript. Requires `transcripts:read` and counts against the 2,000-read daily organization quota.

name: hobbes_v1_list_people
desc: Return prospect profiles aggregated across sessions, ordered by most recently seen.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_get_person
desc: Return one prospect profile by exact email address. URL-encode the email when constructing the request path.

params.name: email
params.desc: Exact prospect email address. URL-encode reserved characters.

name: hobbes_v1_list_accounts
desc: Return B2B account rollups by registrable email domain, ordered by most recently seen.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page

name: hobbes_v1_get_account
desc: Return one account rollup by registrable domain, such as `acme.example`.

name: hobbes_v1_get_metrics
desc: Return aggregate session, qualification, booking, intent, duration, and source metrics for a trailing 1-365 day window.

params.name: days
params.desc: Trailing number of UTC days to aggregate. Defaults to 30 and accepts 1-365.

name: hobbes_v1_list_funnel_events
desc: Return paginated, pseudonymous action-click and lead-submission events for exact pre-email drop-off reporting.

params.name: limit
params.desc: Number of records to return. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 200.

params.name: offset
params.desc: Zero-based number of records to skip. Use with `pagination.total` to request the next page
